claim: Fat signaling in Drosophila depends on the ability of Fat to change the subcellular localization, levels and activity of the unconventional myosin Dachs.
source: Much of the Hippo and planar cell polarity (PCP) signaling mediated by the Drosophila protocadherin Fat depends on its ability to change the subcellular localization, levels and activity of the unconventional myosin Dachs.

claim: Dlish is a novel and important mediator of Fat and Dachs activities.

claim: Dlish is regulated by Fat and Dachs.
